footer.tagline: x402-metered on-chain risk intelligence for autonomous agents on Base.

hero.tagline: x402-metered on-chain risk intelligence for autonomous agents on Base, with a built-in proof-of-fulfillment attestation layer.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Every paid request follows the same verifiable path: no step is hidden or assumed.

quote.title: Request a quote
quote.description: GET /v1/risk-score/:address with no payment returns 402 and the exact x402 payment requirements: price, recipient, asset, and a single-use resourceId.

pay.title: Pay on-chain
pay.description: Send the quoted USDC amount directly to the payTo address. A real, standard ERC-20 transfer: no facilitator, no off-chain step to trust.

fulfill.title: Get the score
fulfill.description: Retry with the transaction hash as proof. The server verifies the payment on-chain (amount, recipient, sender, not-already-used) before releasing anything.

attest.title: Fulfillment is attested
attest.description: An EAS attestation recording exactly what was returned is created on-chain automatically, and its UID comes back in the response: resolvable independently, without trusting this page.

dispute.title: Dispute if something's wrong
dispute.description: POST /v1/disputes against the attestation, signed by the original payer. Filed on-chain, linked to the fulfillment it disputes: a permanent, public record either way.

riskScore.description: x402-gated risk score for a Base address.

metrics.description: Public, unpaid. Real aggregate counters, optionally filtered by network.

disputes.description: File a dispute against a fulfillment attestation, signed by the original payer.
